en.t: Lady Qi was a favored consort of Emperor Gaozu of Han.

units.source_text: 高祖崩，吕后断夫人手足，去眼，熏耳，饮以瘖药，使居厕中，号为“人彘”。

en.t: After Gaozu died, Empress Lu cut off Lady Qi's hands and feet, gouged out her eyes, smoked her ears, forced her to drink a drug that made her mute, and made her live in a latrine, calling her the human swine.
